Modi calls for auto industry innovation for national development

Prime Minister Narendra Modi urged the automotive industry to prioritize transport as a key pillar of national development and to innovate for sustainable growth. He addressed the 66th annual convention of the Society of Indian Automobile Manufacturers (SIAM), encouraging the sector to move from 'Make in India' to 'Create in India'. The Prime Minister emphasized the need for the industry to drive the 'Viksit Bharat' (Developed India) vision through innovation.
